subject: Policy Lab — Reschedule & Prep (prompt review, regional tiers)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Policy Lab — Reschedule & Prep (prompt review, regional tiers)

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for agreeing to the hands-on Policy Lab. We originally had a slot next week but I wanted to check if we can shift given a key attendee conflict on your side. Proposed new windows (US time zones):

- Tue 2027-02-02, 10:00–13:00 PT (deep-dive + prompt pass)
- Wed 2027-02-03, 13:00–16:00 ET (load test + failovers)
- Thu 2027-02-04, 08:00–11:00 PT (shorter, focused on routing tiers)

Session goals: prompt set review, routing policy decisions (model selection & tiering), and a short load-test run to validate regional fallbacks.

Can you confirm which of the above works, and whether your DevOps team can join the load-test portion? I’ll loop in Marissa (solutions lead) and Karthik (infra) to cover prework and capacity.

I’ll attach a short prework pack once we lock time.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

Attachments: (will send policy-lab-prework.pdf)
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@finlytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@finlytics.com>
Date: 2027-01-25T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Policy Lab — Reschedule & Prep (prompt review, regional tiers)

Jordan,

Thanks — appreciate the options. The DevOps lead has a travel conflict on Feb 2. Best options for us:

- Wed 2027-02-03, 13:00–16:00 ET — this looks good for Product + DevOps to be present for the load test.
- Thu 2027-02-04 morning PT — workable if we keep the session focused.

A couple of quick asks before we lock:
- Do you have a short prework checklist we can send to our prompt authors?
- We run production services in us-east-1 with a DR cluster in us-west-2; can you confirm whether you can simulate failover between those regions?
- We also need to know SSO/SCIM access for Marissa during the hands-on lab.

If Feb 3 works on your side, I’ll block calendars and confirm the DevOps engineer.

Best,
Claire Huang
Head of ML Engineering | FinLytics
claire.huang@finlytics.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-25T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Policy Lab — Reschedule & Prep (prompt review, regional tiers)

Claire — perfect, Feb 3 (13:00–16:00 ET) works for us. I’ll mark that as tentative until you confirm the DevOps engineer.

Marissa / Karthik — can you two confirm availability for Feb 3 and whether the team needs any network prep for SSO/SCIM access?

Quick plan for the session (3 hours):
1) 20m — introductions & objectives
2) 50m — prompt review and scoring (we’ll bring sample user traffic)
3) 60m — routing policy walkthrough (model tiers, cost/latency tradeoffs, regional routing)
4) 40m — load test and failover drill (short runs across us-east-1 / us-west-2)
5) 10m — action items & rollouts

I’m attaching the prework pack (stubbed) — it has the prompt checklist, suggested test payloads, and a short SSO checklist. Marissa, the prework also calls out a 30-minute runbook review with DevOps ahead of the load test — can you coordinate?

Thanks,
Jordan

Attachments: policy-lab-prework.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@finlytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-26T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Policy Lab — Reschedule & Prep (prompt review, regional tiers)

Hi Claire + Jordan,

Thanks for confirming — Feb 3 works for me. A few concrete prework items so the hands-on time is productive:

Required (please complete 48h before session):
- Share a representative prompt set (10–20 prompts) in the shared Drive folder.
- Provide a small sample of live request distribution (CSV: endpoint, avg_tokens, concurrency).
- Create an SSO account for marissa.cole@redwood.ai with reviewer role (SCIM invite preferred).

Optional but helpful:
- Any existing reranker or prompt scoring rules you use today.
- A short list of business-critical user flows to prioritize during load tests.

Load test plan (attached loadtest-plan.xlsx) — summary: run three 10-minute passes at 5, 15, and 40 RPS to exercise batching and KV cache behavior. We’ll coordinate the exact window with DevOps to avoid noisy neighbors.

I’m also including a short checklist doc for pre-session infra checks (sso-checklist.docx).

Let me know if you want Marissa to do a 20-minute sync with your prompt authors before Feb 3; happy to run it.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: loadtest-plan.xlsx, sso-checklist.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-26T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Policy Lab — Reschedule & Prep (prompt review, regional tiers)

Hi all — quick infra notes ahead of Feb 3:

- We can simulate regional failover between us-east-1 and us-west-2 during the lab. We’ll run traffic to the primary (us-east-1) and then trigger a controlled fallback to us-west-2. Expect a short penalty in tail latency during cold start for the fallback model variant (we’ll mitigate with warmed caches).
- Please confirm expected concurrent sessions and average token length so we can size the test VM correctly (example: 200 concurrent users, avg 120 tokens).
- For tiering: if you plan to use an expensive 40B model in primary and a quantized 13B in fallback, let us know—we’ll pre-upload the quantized weights to the west cluster to avoid long pulls.

I’ll need SCIM/SSO access by EOD Feb 1 to run through the runbook with your DevOps. If there are org policy blockers, please escalate and I’ll coordinate with our security contacts.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infrastructure Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@finlytics.com>

Subject: Re: Policy Lab — Reschedule & Prep (prompt review, regional tiers)

Jordan / team — thanks for the details. Feb 3 (13:00–16:00 ET) is confirmed from our side; I’ve asked our DevOps engineer (Evan Park) to join for the load test and he’ll follow up on SSO provisioning.

Action items I’ll complete this week:
- Drop representative prompt set in the shared folder (Claire -> shared Drive)
- Provide sample traffic CSV
- Create SCIM invite for marissa.cole@redwood.ai and add Karthik for runbook review

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get this going.

Best,
Claire
